Walled Communities

Your home knows the comfort of a gate and the danger of believing it solves everything.

Who always greeted you from the wall?

Rules

Type: Culture. Status: Proposal. Choose one paired option; do not mix the rank from one with the card from another.

- Armor 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1f6b36c34db9c5eb.JournalEntryPage.36ac9af60144cf5c]{Wear Light Armor}. - Guard 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.f90d324afc1f7997.JournalEntryPage.0a730e9328c623f4]{Shielding Step}.

Grant at level 0. Duplicate grants provide 1 stage DP each; never promote a rank automatically. No discipline purchases at level 0. Ancestry does not restrict this choice. Follow each card’s explicit equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +10 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
